''See also: [[Icon Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|An Icon is a symbol representing a significant concept of reality and serves as a connection to powers beyond the world. It is a fundamental component for those seeking to become [[Sages]], who must contact these greater powers by becoming symbols of specific concepts themselves. To manifest an Icon, an individual must deeply understand their [[madra]] and undergo years of intense willpower training to refine their focus and concentration. The specific Icon a person manifests is determined by the nature of their [[madra]] and a concept that has been central to their identity since childhood. While an individual can possess multiple [[Icons]], having a greater number provides versatility rather than increased power. A [[Sage]]'s unique relationship with their Icon allows them to perform specific abilities that other [[Sages]] cannot. Examples of [[Icons]] include [[The Sword|the Sword]], Winter, [[Strength]], Void, [[Death]], and Life, among many others. Historically, some cultures used carved badges to represent the specific Icon a person intended to embody.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|An Icon is a symbol representing a greater concept of reality that appears in the sky during an ascension to [[Sage]]. During her journey, [[Yerin]] has touched the [[Sword Icon]], while the [[Winter Sage]] successfully manifested the [[Winter Icon]]. The process of manifestation requires intense critical focus along with a deep sensing and understanding of the significance of one's [[madra]]. Ultimately, the specific Icon that manifests is determined by a core concept of an individual's identity and the nature of their [[madra]].}}
